description: The test-writer's record: the tests written, which acceptance criteria each covers, and the result of running them before the change exists (against today's code, or against the stubs of a brand-new module).

name.description: The test's name as it appears in its file (for example test_fetch_retries): the gate opens `file` and looks for it.

ac_ids.description: The acceptance criteria this test covers.

files_written.description: Every file the test-writer wrote, the stubs under the run's stubs directory included.

stub_check.description: Run against today's code, or against stubs of a brand-new module: every test should fail when it runs, on an assertion or (outside a fix) on the import of a name the change has yet to add, and not pass or fail at collection. In a fix every test must fail on an assertion. all_failed_on_assertions is true when that holds.
